// Independent capture: Tarsee's own run() -> the real SDK 0.3.319 -> a stub in place of `claude`.
// Written from scratch for the verification pass; it shares nothing with tests/fixtures/claude-cli/scripts.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const SCRATCH = process.env.VERIFY_SCRATCH;
const NODE_PROJECT = process.env.TARSEE_NODE_PROJECT;
const STATE = path.join(SCRATCH, "state");
const HOME = path.join(SCRATCH, "home");
const WS = path.join(SCRATCH, "ws");
const OUT = path.join(SCRATCH, "out");
for (const d of [STATE, HOME, WS, OUT]) fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true });

// Tarsee's config module creates its state folder on import: keep that inside the scratch folder.
process.env.TARSEE_STATE_DIR = STATE;
process.env.TARSEE_API_TOKEN = "made-up-api-token";
process.env.CLAUDE_DEFAULT_MODEL = "sonnet";
delete process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;

const imp = (rel) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(NODE_PROJECT, rel)).href);
const { run, buildQueryOptions } = await imp("src/ai/providers/claude-code.js");
const sdk = await imp("node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs");
const STUB = path.join(SCRATCH, "stub", "fake-claude.exe").replace(/\//g, "\\");

const only = process.argv.slice(2);

function serverEnv(extra = {}) {
  // A made-up "server environment": the system names a process needs, plus canaries the rules must strip or keep.
  const keep = {};
  for (const k of ["PATH", "PATHEXT", "SystemRoot", "SystemDrive", "COMSPEC", "TEMP", "TMP", "windir"]) if (process.env[k]) keep[k] = process.env[k];
  return {
    ...keep,
    HOME, USERPROFILE: HOME,
    NODE_OPTIONS: "--max-old-space-size=2048",
    DEBUG: "canary",
    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: "made-up-key-that-must-be-stripped",
    ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: "http://should-be-stripped.invalid",
    CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: "<PLAN_OAUTH_TOKEN>",
    CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: "X:/should-be-stripped",
    OPENAI_API_KEY: "made-up-openai",
    DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: "made-up-railway-deepseek",
    TARSEE_MCP_TOKEN: "made-up-mcp-token",
    ENCRYPTION_KEY: "made-up-encryption",
    VERIFY_PLAIN: "kept",
    ...extra,
  };
}

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const PNG = "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==";

async function capture(name, { scenario = "turn", runOpts = {}, depsExtra = {}, envExtra = {}, abortAtMs = null, preAbort = false, exe = STUB, queryExtra = null, timeoutMs = 30000 }) {
  if (only.length && !only.some((o) => name.startsWith(o))) return;
  const stubOut = path.join(OUT, `${name}.stub.jsonl`);
  fs.rmSync(stubOut, { force: true });
  const env = serverEnv({ VSTUB_OUT: stubOut, VSTUB_SCENARIO: scenario, ...envExtra });
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const rel = () => Date.now() - t0;
  const calls = [];
  const ac = new AbortController();
  if (preAbort) ac.abort();
  let sdkError = null;
  const seen = [];
  const query = ({ prompt, options }) => {
    const o = { ...options, pathToClaudeCodeExecutable: exe, ...(queryExtra ? queryExtra(options) : {}) };
    // watch the process the SDK started (its pid comes from the SDK's own onProcessSpawned callback)
    o.onProcessSpawned = (pid) => {
      calls.push({ t: rel(), ev: "process started, pid known" });
      const iv = setInterval(() => { try { process.kill(pid, 0); } catch { calls.push({ t: rel(), ev: "process gone (polled every 10 ms)" }); clearInterval(iv); } }, 10);
      iv.unref?.();
    };
    calls.push({ t: rel(), promptKind: typeof prompt === "string" ? "string" : "async generator", prompt: typeof prompt === "string" ? prompt : null, options: describe(o) });
    const q = sdk.query({ prompt, options: o });
    // pass the messages through, noting each and any error the stream ends with
    return (async function* () {
      try { for await (const m of q) { seen.push({ t: rel(), type: m.type, subtype: m.subtype ?? m.event?.type }); yield m; } }
      catch (e) { sdkError = { t: rel(), name: e?.name, message: e?.message }; throw e; }
      finally { calls.push({ t: rel(), ev: "sdk stream finished" }); }
    })();
  };
  const events = [];
  const logs = [];
  const orig = { log: console.log, warn: console.warn, error: console.error };
  for (const k of Object.keys(orig)) console[k] = (...a) => logs.push({ t: rel(), level: k, text: a.map((x) => (x instanceof Error ? `${x.name}: ${x.message}` : typeof x === "string" ? x : JSON.stringify(x))).join(" ") });
  let abortAt = null;
  const timer = abortAtMs != null ? setTimeout(() => { abortAt = rel(); ac.abort(); }, abortAtMs) : null;
  const guard = setTimeout(() => { events.push({ t: rel(), type: "HARNESS-TIMEOUT" }); ac.abort(); }, timeoutMs);
  let handles = [];
  try {
    for await (const e of run({
      target: { providerId: "claude" }, messages: [{ role: "user", content: "say hi" }], systemPrompt: "SYSTEM PROMPT TEXT",
      signal: ac.signal, cwd: WS, onSessionHandle: (id) => handles.push({ t: rel(), id }),
      ...runOpts,
      deps: { query, env, stateDir: STATE, homeDir: HOME, vaultEnv: { MY_VAULT_KEY: "vault-value" }, mcpServer: null, store: null, isTranscriptOverCap: () => false, ...depsExtra },
    })) events.push({ t: rel(), ...e });
  } catch (e) { events.push({ t: rel(), type: "RUN-THREW", message: e?.message }); }
  finally { clearTimeout(timer); clearTimeout(guard); for (const k of Object.keys(orig)) console[k] = orig[k]; }
  const endedAt = rel();
  await sleep(scenario === "bad-key-source" ? 6500 : scenario.startsWith("hang") ? 6000 : 150);
  const stub = fs.existsSync(stubOut) ? fs.readFileSync(stubOut, "utf8").trim().split("\n").filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l)) : [];
  const start = stub.find((r) => r.ev === "start");
  const rec = {
    name, scenario, abortAt, endedAt,
    query_calls: calls,
    argv: start?.argv ?? null, cwd: start?.cwd ?? null,
    env_received: start?.env ?? null,
    stdin: stub.filter((r) => r.ev === "stdin").map((r) => ({ t: r.t, bytes: r.bytes, raw: r.raw, json: r.json })),
    stub_timeline: stub.filter((r) => r.ev !== "start" && r.ev !== "stdin").map((r) => ({ t: r.t, ev: r.ev, type: r.type, subtype: r.subtype, code: r.code, why: r.why })),
    sdk_messages_seen: seen, sdk_error: sdkError,
    tarsee_events: events, tarsee_logs: logs, session_handles: handles,
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${name}.json`), JSON.stringify(rec, null, 1));
  orig.log(`${name}: argv ${rec.argv ? rec.argv.length : "none"}, stdin ${rec.stdin.length}, events ${events.map((e) => e.type + (e.stopReason ? ":" + e.stopReason : "")).join(",").slice(0, 200)}`);
  return rec;
}

function describe(o) {
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o)) {
    if (k === "env") out.env = v;
    else if (k === "abortController") out[k] = `<AbortController aborted=${v.signal.aborted}>`;
    else if (typeof v === "function") out[k] = "<function>";
    else if (k === "mcpServers") out[k] = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).map(([n, s]) => [n, s?.instance ? { type: s.type, name: s.name, instance: "<McpServer>" } : s]));
    else out[k] = v;
  }
  return out;
}

// ---- the combinations -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  runOpts: { target: { providerId: "claude", model: "opus", effort: "high" }, systemPrompt: undefined, systemParts: { stable: "STABLE PART", volatile: "VOLATILE PART" }, sessionId: SESSION, thinkingSummaries: true },
});

  scenario: "turn-slow",
  runOpts: { messages: [{ role: "user", content: [{ type: "image", source: { type: "base64", media_type: "image/png", data: PNG } }, { type: "text", text: "what is this? h\u00e9llo \u4f60\u597d \ud83d\ude42" }] }] },
});

  scenario: "turn-slow",

  depsExtra: { mcpServer: undefined },
});

});
await capture("k-stop-hang", { scenario: "hang", abortAtMs: 600 });
